features.featureTitle: In the app header in App.tsx, display the text 'Understand Virality Through Mathematics' directly beside the logo image (frontend/public/assets/generated/logo.png). The tagline should be placed to the right of the logo, styled to match the existing Gen Z dark aesthetic — use a gradient or light-colored font consistent with the current header typography, appropriate font size for mobile readability (e.g., text-sm to text-base), and ensure the logo + tagline are horizontally aligned and centered or left-aligned within the glassmorphism header.
